content.body:
Hi all! Riki from Sony Interactive Entertainment here 👋 🇯🇵

We’re excited to welcome TC39 back to Japan in about 3 weeks!

Just a friendly reminder to fill out the [In-Person Registration Form](https://forms.gle/PwJ5b6NUTqkjaiBn9) if you’re planning to attend in person. **Registration is a MUST**, and there may be some very serious consequences™ if you show up on the day without letting us know 👹

Looking forward to seeing everyone in Japan ♥️
